name: autonomy/video
notes: Static ffmpeg/ffprobe (johnvansickle build, sha256-pinned in install/ffmpeg.pin) populated into bin/ by host-install; bin/ is resolved state, gitignored. Tools are bash wrappers over the pinned binaries. ffmpeg and ffprobe are also exposed on PATH so agent-browser can finalize browser recordings without a per-session install. First consumers: browser-animation verification, the evidence-capture pipeline's gallery-to-animation compilation (auto-vztz5), and analysis of operator screen recordings.
